**How To Begin:** Speak to [Irina](#loc=164637) until she gives you _Irina's Letter_

**Steps:** 
1. Talk to  [Irina](#loc=164637) and she'll give you Irina's Letter, which she asks you to deliver to her father [Edgar](#loc=164794) in [Castle Morne](#loc=163951).
2. [Edgar](#loc=164794) tell you that he can't leave until he's made sure that the [legendary sword](#loc=164813) of [Castle Morne](#loc=163951) isn't going to be claimed by the **Misbegotten** first. He'll also give a [Sacrificial Twig](#loc=164795)
3. Head back to [Irina's location](#loc=164637). She'll be dead, with an **Iron Cleaver** embedded in the ground next to her.
4. Head back to [Castle Morne](#loc=163951), and this time progress through it and down to the Southernmost point, down to the beach. There'll be a boss fight with an enemy called the [Leonine Misbegotten](#loc=164812).
5. Killing the [Leonine Misbegotten](#loc=164812) gives you the [Grafted Blade Greatsword](#loc=164813). Take it back to [Edgar](#loc=164794) - he won't take it off you, just simply need to prove that the **Misbegotten** won't get hold of it. He thanks you and says he's going to go see [Irina](#loc=164637) now his duty's done.
6. Head back to  [Irina](#loc=164637) for a third time and you'll find **Edgar** mourning over her body. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue.
7. **Edgar** reappears as a hostile NPC invader called [Edgar the Revenger](#loc=166811), found at the [Revenger's Shack](#loc=166810).

166648:
**Warning:** Beginning this quest before [Sorcerer Rogier](#loc=168232) instructs you to during [Rogier's Quest](#loc=169102), will cause the latter to become unavailable.

**How to Begin:** Speak with [Ranni the Witch](#loc=166221)  
**Steps:**
1. Exhaust all dialogue options with Iji, Blaidd, and Seluvis at the bottom of the tower
2. Speak with [Blaidd](#loc=167764) in the Siofra River
3. Speak with [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) to obtain Seluvis's Introduction
4. Speak with [Sorceress Sellen](#loc=164616)
5. Defeat [Starscourge Radahn](#loc=165444)
6. Enter [Nokron, Eternal City](#loc=167493) and retrieve the [Fingerslayer Blade](#loc=170239)
7. Give the Fingerslayer Blade to [Ranni the Witch](#loc=166221) (doing so will prevent completion of [Seluvis' Quest](#loc=169060) if incomplete)
8. Ascend the [Divine Tower of Liurnia](#loc=164411) and retrieve the [Cursemark of Death](#loc=169305)
9. Go to [Ainsel River Main](#loc=167480) and pick up the Miniature Ranni that sits on the coffin
10. Rest at the Site of Grace and speak with the Miniature Ranni (you may need to activate the dialogue option multiple times before she responds)
11. Defeat the [Baleful Shadow](#loc=168546) to obtain the [Discarded Palace Key](#loc=176421)
12. Go to [Raya Lucaria Grand Library](#loc=164426) and retrieve the [Dark Moon Ring](#loc=177447)
13. Go back to Ainsel River and traverse the Lake of Rot ([Flame, Cleanse Me](#loc=166672) is very helpful for this)
14. Enter the [Portal to Astel, Naturalborn of the Void](#loc=168579)
15. Defeat [Astel, Naturalborn of the Void](#loc=167488) and retrieve [Remembrance of the Naturalborn](#loc=170488)
16. Take the [elevator](#loc=168601) to the north up to the [Moonlight Altar](#loc=166807) 
17. Enter the [Cathedral of Manus Sellus](#loc=165510)
18. Use the [Dark Moon Ring](#loc=177447) with Miniature Ranni and retrieve the [Dark Moon Greatsword](#loc=167891)

**How to Begin:** Speak to [Rya](#loc=166413)  
**Steps:**
1. Go to the [Boilprawn Shack](#loc=166185) and speak with [Blackguard](#loc=166187)
2. Purchase [Rya's Necklace](#loc=177671) for 1000 Runes (you can kill [Blackguard](#loc=166187), but it is not recommended as he has his own [questline](#loc=177672))
3. Return the [necklace](#loc=177671) to [Rya](#loc=166413) to receive the [Volcano Manor Invitation](#loc=166812)
4. Speak with Rya at her new location either [near the Grand Lift of Dectus](#loc=169808) or [at the Lux Ruins](#loc=176450)
5. Gain access to the [Volcano Manor](#loc=164405) and begin [Tanith's Quest](#loc=178114)
6. Speak with Rya in her [new location](#loc=178115)
7. Progress [Tanith's Quest](#loc=178114) until after the first assassination
8. Speak with Rya (Zorayas) in her [new location](#loc=169809) 
9. Progress [Tanith's Quest](#loc=178114) until after the second assassination
10. Speak with [Rya](#loc=169809) about the secret passage
11. Use the secret passage to go to the [Prison Town Church](#loc=168026) Site of Grace and open the church doors just beyond
12. Report back to [Rya](#loc=169809)
13. Go to the [Temple of Eiglay](#loc=167423) and defeat the [Godskin Noble](#loc=168177)
14. Retrieve the [Serpent's Amnion](#loc=168772) and return it to [Rya](#loc=169809)
15. _Optional_ - Reload the area, then speak with [Tanith](#loc=167573) about Rya and obtain the [Tonic of Forgetfulness](#loc=178118)
16. Go and speak with Rya in her [new location](#loc=178116)
17. Do ONE of the following: 
    - Kill Rya.  This ends her quest and she drops [Daedicar's Woe](#loc=176504)
    - Give Rya the [Tonic of Forgetfulness](#loc=178118).  This makes her go to sleep
    - Spare Rya and do not give her the [Tonic](#loc=178118).  Return to [her location](#loc=178116) later after defeating [Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy](#loc=167571) to find [Daedicar's Woe](#loc=176504) and [Zorayas's Letter](#loc=178117)

167784:
**How to Begin:** Speak to [Diallos](#loc=167783) at [Roundtable Hold](#loc=165686)

**Steps:**
1. After talking with Diallos at the Roundtable Hold, you'll find him at his [second location](#loc=167227) to the North and slightly West of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace in Northern Liurnia atop a sunken roof.
Diallos is standing at ground level west of the grace on the northern edge of the town ruins. If you look on the map, he's located at almost exactly the rightmost tip of the Academy Gate Town icon.
2. He will then be at the Roundtable Hold again. Exhaust his dialogue and then he'll be at [Volcano Manor](#loc=164405), in the drawing room, having decided to join the organization. Diallos will have new dialogue when the character progressed through the Volcano Manor. If the Volcano Manor quest line is finished Diallos will disappear.
3. After completing the second letter from Volcano Manor, he will leave the manor and relocate to [Jarburg](#loc=166209).
4. After progressing the Jarburg questline he will appear in one of the shacks, tending to a little jar.
If you are having trouble continuing the Jarburg questline, try talking to [Jar-Bairn](#loc=170335) and exhausting all its dialogue options, and then passing time at the nearby grace. You may have to do this multiple times.
5. After seeing him in [Jarburg](#loc=166209), let some time pass. Once enough time has passed, and you can talk to Diallos once more. After exhausting dialogue with him and Jar-Bairn you can rest to advance the quest.
6. After passing enough time, [Jarburg](#loc=166209) is attacked and Diallos is wounded. You can talk to him and he'll ask if he was able to defend the jars, to which you can tell him he succeeded or he failed. He will die shortly after. Upon reloading the area, Jar-Bairn will move over to Diallos, "eating" his remains for his power.
7. After some time, Diallos’s body will disappear, leaving behind Diallos's Mask, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and a Numen's Rune where he was last encountered.

**Requirements:** Begin [Ranni's Quest](#loc=166648) and progress until you talk with a ghostly Seluvis.

**Warning:** Giving the potion to anyone besides [Gideon Ofnir](#loc=169061) will end the respective person's questline.

**How to Begin:** Speak to [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) in his [tower](#loc=165495) and exhaust all dialogue options.      
**Steps:**  
- There are 3 major options for administering the potion:
    - Give the potion to Nepheli.  Her [questline](#loc=169124) will end.  Continue this questline to gain her as a puppet.
    - You can give the potion to [Milos (Dung Eater)](#loc=168118) provided his [questline](#loc=169072) has been progressed to where he's locked in a chair.  His questline will end.  Continue this questline to gain him as a puppet.
    - Tell [Gideon Ofnir](#loc=169061) about the potion and give it to him to dispose of.  No questlines will end.  Continue this questline to gain a generic puppet.
1. Go to the [Roundtable Hold](#loc=165686) and speak with [Gideon Ofnir](#loc=169061) about Nepheli
2. If not done already - progress [Nepheli's Quest](#loc=169124) until after you defeat the [Omenkiller](#loc=166426)
3. Speak with Nepheli in the [Roundtable Hold](#loc=165686)
4. Speak with [Gideon Ofnir](#loc=169061) about Nepheli
5. Give the potion to [Gideon Ofnir](#loc=169061) OR [Nepheli Loux](#loc=171950) OR [Dung Eater](#loc=168118)
6. Return to [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) for your reward
7. Find and explore all of [Seluvis's Hidden Cellar](#loc=168240)
8. Return again to [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) who will sell you a puppet.
9. Purchase all puppets and any sorceries [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) sells.  Then ask him "About the Scheme".
10. Obtain the [Amber Starlight Shard](#loc=167876) and return it to [Seluvis](#loc=165877)
11. Exhaust his dialogue options and he will reward you with the [Magic Scorpion Charm](#loc=169028)
12. Rest, reload the area and speak with him again to obtain the [Amber Draught](#loc=177296)
13. Give the Draught to [Ranni the Witch](#loc=166221).  She will be offended and cast you away (this will end her [questline](#loc=166648) until you absolve yourself by offering a Celestial Dew at the [Church of Vows](#loc=165501))
14. Return to [Preceptor Seluvis](#loc=165877) to find [Seluvis’s Bell Bearing](#loc=169026) and [Preceptor's Set](#loc=168975)

**How to Begin:** Speak with [Varré](#loc=164440) and exhaust all dialogue options.    
**Steps:**

2. Speak with [Varré](#loc=164440) again at the [The First Step](#loc=163930)
3. Destroy [Godrick the Grafted](#loc=164421)
4. Speak with [Finger Reader Enia](#loc=170553) in the [Roundtable Hold](#loc=165686) 
5. Speak with [Varré (Second Location)](#loc=166244) at the [Rose Church](#loc=165504)
6.  Use a Festering Bloody Fingers to invade another player's world 3 different times (combat outcome irrelevant). If playing offline, invade and kill [Magnus the Beast Claw](#loc=196316) or die to him three times.
7. Speak with [Varré (Second Location)](#loc=166244) in front of the [Rose Church](#loc=165504)
8. Soak the cloth in maiden's blood (recommended to find dead maidens in the [Church of Inhibition](#loc=165517)
9. Speak with [Varré (Second Location)](#loc=166244) again for some loot
10. Use the Pureblood Knight's Medal to travel to [Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum](#loc=168582)
11. Kill the Nameless White Mask on location in the Blood Swamp after he invades 3 times to obtain his armor and mask - 
    - [Nameless White Mask](#loc=170262)
    - [Nameless White Mask](#loc=170263)
    - [Nameless White Mask](#loc=170264)
12. Go activate the [White Mask Varré](#loc=174889) summoning sigil to invade Varré's world and defeat him
13. After returning to your world, speak with Varré to obtain your reward.

178114:
**How to Begin:** Speak with [Tanith](#loc=167573) upon gaining access to the [Volcano Manor](#loc=164405)  
**Steps:**
1.	When asked if you would like to join the Volcano Manor family, say yes and she will give you the Drawing-Room Key. This will allow you to access the other dorms and meet the other NPCs in the area.
2.	Once you enter the room with Rya, there will be a Letter from Volcano Manor left on the table for you along with a Recusant Finger. Read the note and return to Tanith where she will tell you to assassinate Old Knight Istvan. 
      •	In order to assassinate Istvan, you will need to invade him back in Stormhill, next to the Divine Bridge.
3.	Return to Tanith and you'll be rewarded with Magma Shot.
4.	Reload. In the room with Knight Bernahl (second/third left door in hallway) will be a Letter from Volcano Manor on the table for you. Read the note and then assassinate Rileigh the Idle in Altus Plateau.
5.	Return to Tanith and you'll be rewarded with the Serpentbone Blade.
6.	Reload. In the room with Knight Bernahl will be a Red Letter on the table for you. It tells you to assassinate Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood. His invasion mark is located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
7.	Return to Tanith and you'll be rewarded with Taker's Cameo.
      •	Note: If you have defeated Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy before returning, the reward will appear on the table on the same spot as the letters.
8.	Once you have completed her assassination quests, she will ask if you would like to meet their lord. Accepting her request takes you directly to a site of grace immediately before the boss Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
9.	Once you have defeated Rykard, return to Tanith and speak to her once more.
10.	Once Tanith has disappeared from Volcano Manor, you will find her back in Rykard's boss area feasting on his corpse.
11.	At this stage you can give her Dancer's Castanets that you receive from Patches at the Shaded Castle, although this doesn't seem to any known effect.
12.	She can be killed. Doing so causes Tanith's Knight to invade you. Upon defeat he will drop Aspect of the Crucible: Breath and Tanith's attire, Consort's Set, will be found where she left;
      •	Note: It is unconfirmed whether this is her final destination. Reports have shown she will still be eating Rykard's corpse at the end of the game. Receiving the Dancer's Castanets from Patches will not continue her quest after Rykard is defeated.
